test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 15 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following countries is the venue for the 2025 Esports World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Riyadh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Riyadh**, the capital of **Saudi Arabia**, has been designated as the permanent host city for the **Esports World Cup (EWC)**, including the upcoming **2025** edition.
 
• The tournament is an annual international esports competition that replaced the previous **Gamers8** festival, which was also held in **Saudi Arabia**.
 
• The announcement of the **Esports World Cup** was made by **Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman** in **October 2023**, aiming to establish the kingdom as a premier global hub for gaming and esports.
 
• The **Esports World Cup Foundation**, a non-profit organization, is responsible for organizing the event and managing the massive scale of the competition.
 
• The event features a unique **cross-game competition** format where professional esports clubs from across the globe compete in various titles to earn points for a collective club championship. ***Hence, the correct answer is Riyadh.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Gaming and Esports Strategy:**
 
 
• Launched in **September 2022**, this strategy is a core component of **Saudi Vision 2030**.
 
• It aims to increase the sector's contribution to the **GDP** by more than **SAR 50 billion** (approximately **$13.3 billion**) by **2030**.
 
• The strategy intends to create **39,000 new job opportunities** within the gaming industry by the end of the decade.
 
 
 
• **Vision 2030 and Economic Diversification:**
 
 
• **Saudi Arabia** is investing heavily in the **entertainment and sports** sectors to reduce its economic reliance on oil.
 
• The **Public Investment Fund (PIF)** has established **Savvy Games Group**, which has spent billions of dollars acquiring major gaming entities like **ESL FaceIt Group** and **Scopely**.
 
 
 
• **Prize Pool and Global Impact:**
 
 
• The **2024** inaugural edition set a record for the largest prize pool in esports history, exceeding **$60 million**.
 
• The event attracts millions of viewers globally and brings together elite athletes from games such as **League of Legends**, **Dota 2**, **Counter-Strike 2**, **StarCraft II**, and **Mobile Legends: Bang Bang**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Tournament Structure:**
 
 
• Unlike traditional single-title tournaments, the **Esports World Cup** focuses on **Club Excellence**. This means organizations like **Team Liquid**, **FaZe Clan**, or **G2 Esports** compete across multiple games to be crowned the ultimate champion club.
 
• The **2025** edition is expected to expand even further with more game titles and a larger qualifying structure involving regional qualifiers in **Europe**, **Asia**, and the **Americas**.
 
 
 
• **Infrastructure:**
 
 
• The venue in **Riyadh** features state-of-the-art facilities at **Boulevard City**, including specialized arenas for different game genres (FPS, MOBA, Battle Royale).
 
• This infrastructure is designed to accommodate the **summer season** peak, making **Riyadh** a major tourist destination during the tournament months.
